Does not currently pay attention to Juice.

Understands individual basic emotion effects but ignores emotion management.

Uses Headbutt with Aubrey sometimes, but it is not her default action.
Whether other characters favor skills over basic attacks is unknown.
Usually attacks one enemy with the whole party.
